2908.title: Compact right panel ignores mobile safe areas
2908.rootCauseOneLine: The body-portaled fixed shelf starts at viewport edge zero and does not apply the safe-area padding used by the app shell.

prReviews.verdict: ADDRESSES ROOT CAUSE — static review only
prReviews.topFinding: The two-file diff adds the four safe-area padding values to the shelf and checks the new class contract. I did not run its branch.

2908.proposedFix: Apply the app shell's four safe-area padding values to the fixed shelf and keep the focused component test.
2908.caveats: The visual run used Chrome device metrics and a 59-pixel safe-area override. The same agent repeated the focused test in a second clean clone.
